items.text: ETR has Zay Flowers (hamstring) out in projections right now; still possible he plays, keep late swap in mind for Bateman/Andrews DFS. No new info yet on DJ Moore or AD Mitchell.
items.why: Team not counting on him; hamstring history.
items.implication: Sit Flowers; elevate backups in Ravens pass game.

items.text: ETR Sunday AM summary: GTD Flowers (not counting on), Spears hopeful. Expected: Warren, Pittman, Barkley, Smith, Bowers, Evans, Coker, Coleman. Q: Parkinson trending right, Bagent.
items.implication: Clear starts for expected group; monitor Flowers closely.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams has Grade 2 hamstring injury doctors consider 3-to-4-week injury. Noted quick healer hoping to beat timeline. Already out this week.
items.why: Grade 2 hamstring strain confirmed by sources.
items.implication: Bagent or next man up for multiple weeks; Bears pass catchers downgraded.
items.opportunity: Rome Odunze/Luther Burden/DJ Moore? Wait Bears WRs with backup QB risk.

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman (foot/plantar), listed questionable, is expected to play vs Bengals. Back after one week.
items.why: Plantar fasciitis; expected after one week absence.
items.implication: Start Pittman; Steelers WR hierarchy restored.

items.text: Steelers RB Jaylen Warren (shoulder), listed questionable, is expected to play vs Bengals.
items.implication: Start Warren confidently; Dowdle already OUT.
items.opportunity: Full lead back role with Dowdle out.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) is a true pre-game decision; team working him out but does not sound like it is counting on him playing vs Cowboys.
items.why: Hamstring; true pregame workout needed; team not counting on him.
items.implication: Project limited or out; prepare late swap.
items.opportunity: Increased targets to Bateman/Andrews if out or limited.

items.text: Saquon Barkley and Devonta Smith expected to play (Barkley after stinger). ETR lists both expected; Levitan projecting in.
items.why: Stinger for Barkley resolved enough; Smith clear.
items.implication: Lock in both for MNF/PHI offense.

items.text: Brock Bowers (knee) expected to play despite Q tag. Levitan projecting IN.

Rams WR Puka Nacua doubtful for SNF at Denver; mainly groin impacting explosiveness. Functionally can play but not at full explosiveness. Short-term; could return next week vs Eagles. Surgery not expected but not entirely off table.
items.why: Groin limiting explosiveness; no practice all week.
items.implication: Sit Nacua; Adams full WR1 role.
items.opportunity: Davante Adams target/route monopoly; Ferguson TE upside.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins ruled out second straight week (hamstring); has a decent chance to return Week 4 vs Cowboys.
items.opportunity: Dalton Schultz 28-30% target share continuation; other HOU WRs volume.

items.text: Panthers WR Jalen Coker (ankle) should play today; Xavier Legette (knee) GTD.
items.implication: Start Coker if rostered; monitor Legette.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans (hip) good to go / plans to play vs Arizona. ETR and Levitan projecting IN.
items.why: Hip; plans to play per source.

items.text: Berry loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop (88.5); DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite matchup vs poor rush D; high prop.
items.opportunity: Volume and efficiency vs weak front.

items.text: Berry loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches + 15% target share both games; RB7 util; PIT 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Berry loves Chris Olave vs LV (double-digit tgts, high aDOT, LV allows 18.7 ypr to WRs) and Dalton Schultz @ IND (28% tgt share w/ Collins out; IND 4th-most yds to TEs).
items.why: Volume + matchup for both; Collins absence for Schultz.
items.opportunity: Olave air yards; Schultz TE target vacuum.

items.text: Berry hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX (post-fumble 31% snaps/5 touches; JAX stout vs RBs) and Travis Etienne vs LV (only 49% touches/38% 3rd-down snaps even w/ Kamara).
items.opportunity: Henderson upside if Stevenson limited; NO committee mess.

items.text: Berry hates Terry McLaurin vs SEA: SEA fewest FP to WRs, 7.9 ypr allowed; WAS lowest implied total. Daniels out but history w/ Mariota solid; still tough spot.
items.why: Elite matchup defense + low team total + QB change.

items.text: 10 Facts: After Stevenson fumble, Henderson 65% snaps and 16-5 touches rest of game (still ranks Stevenson ahead W3). Schultz 30% routes targeted / 28% tgt share w/ Collins out; faces IND soft vs TEs.
items.why: Post-fumble snap/touch shift; Collins absence target spike.
items.implication: Henderson handcuff/flex upside; Schultz TE start.
items.opportunity: Henderson role expansion potential; Schultz vacuum.
items.conflict: Berry still ranks Stevenson ahead short-term.
